Thanks Marissa — Wed May 12, 10:00–11:00 PDT works best for us.

Quick answers to your sizing questions:
- Target sustained throughput: 250,000 tokens / minute
- Peak burst: 350,000 tokens / minute for short windows (~2–5 min)
- Typical sequence length: 120 tokens (avg), 512 tokens max for a minority of requests
- Concurrent requesters: ~45 workers during peak

We've attached a small sample of traffic to help with synthetic workload creation.

See you on May 12. I'll accept the calendar invite once sent.

Alex
